entries.391864dc044c85f8: It is a channel that sells directly to accommodation facilities such as hotels, in which it takes part in planning beds and interiors for hotels and commercial spaces from the planning stage and produces the entire project from proposal through construction. entries.7191d344ce291e2e: A bedding and furniture manufacturer that makes mattresses, bed frames, sofas and bedding, and sells them to furniture retailers, hotels and others.

entries.8b2e029d7a0d6b95: It is a channel that sells directly to general consumers at 6 Lean Rosé shops in Tokyo, Aichi, Osaka and Fukuoka prefectures, and sells through 4 showrooms in Hiroshima, Tokyo, Osaka and Aichi prefectures. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,702 million.
